attchmntText: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited received a credit rating letter from CRISIL Ratings Ltd. dated November 6, 2026. The letter confirms the enhancement of total bank loan facilities from Rs. 250 Crore to Rs. 320 Crore. The long-term credit rating is Crisil A- with a Stable outlook. The short-term credit rating is Crisil A2+. The existing credit ratings have been reaffirmed without any change. The rating letter remains valid until March 31, 2027. If the company does not avail the proposed facilities within 180 days from the letter date, a fresh revalidation letter from CRISIL Ratings will be necessary.

attchmntText: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding submission of Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 in respect of utilization of funds raised through Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and warrants, issued by CRISIL Ratings Limited
voiceSummary: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of funds from a Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and warrants totaling Rs. 325.00 crore. The Audit Committee and Board of Directors reviewed and approved the report during their meeting on November 7, 2026. During the quarter, Rs. 31.67 crore was utilized. Rs. 7.48 crore was applied to repay borrowings, and Rs. 24.19 crore was used for payments to suppliers under General Corporate Purpose. Unutilized proceeds of Rs. 293.33 crore remain, including Rs. 255.83 crore in the share application account. The company confirmed no deviations from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document.

attchmntText: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on 7th November, 2026. The company published these results in The Times of India and Divya Marathi in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The publication is also available on the company website at www.spectrum-india.com.

attchmntText: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr. Narendra Daulatrao Wagh as a Director on the Board of its Material Subsidiary, Alric Electric Private Limited, subject to approval by the Board of Alric Electric Private Limited. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 19,078.25 lakhs, and profit for the year was Rs. 1,845.91 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 11.65 basic and Rs. 11.47 diluted. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 34,666.15 lakhs, and profit for the year was Rs. 3,175.02 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 20.01 basic and Rs. 19.70 diluted. The Limited Review Reports were issued by SHARP AARTH & CO LLP.
